purpose: Narration scripts reference V5 numbered art without changing saves

scenes.speaker: Vesper Vane
scenes.dialogue: The Forgotten Archive is open. The silver threads are responding to the relics, but something is moving beyond the doorway.
scenes.narration: Moonlight crosses the ancient floor as the seals of the Netherese-Barovian Archive flicker.

scenes.speaker: Vaelthara
scenes.dialogue: Protect the living first. The dead can wait for judgment; the innocent cannot.
scenes.narration: A bell sounds over the Abbey of Three Lights as distant shapes gather in the mist.

scenes.speaker: Strahd von Zarovich
scenes.dialogue: You have crossed into my domain, little witch. Every door here opens at my pleasure.
scenes.narration: Castle Ravenloft stands beyond the rain, its highest tower briefly illuminated by lightning.
